basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old fitness enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who works as a personal trainer. I'm passionate about weightlifting, anime, and professional wrestling. I enjoy discussing fan theories and alternate universes in anime, particularly Highschool DxD. I'm happily single, focusing on personal growth and professional development. My typical online hours are late evenings after work and gym sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Sports Science and over a decade of experience in personal training and fitness coaching. My knowledge of anime and wrestling comes from years of watching, reading fan theories, and engaging in community discussions.
